 Anne Hathaway gives birth to baby No. 3 with husband Adam Shulman 
 By 
 Riley Cardoza 
 Published 
 Nov. 17, 2026, 4:48 p.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Mother Anne.
 Anne Hathaway has given birth to her and husband Adam Shulman’s third baby.
 The 44-year-old actress was spotted walking around New York City with her newborn on Tuesday, carrying the baby in a brown carrier as she strolled with a friend, according to TMZ .
 She kept it casual in white pants, a purple cardigan and a long gray coat, accessorizing with a brown cap and sunglasses.
 Page Six has reached out to representatives for Hathaway for comment.
 The “Mother Mary” star’s new arrival joins brothers Jonathan and Jack, who were born in 2016 and 2019, respectively.

 The “Devil Wears Prada 2” star announced in a June Instagram post that she and Shulman, 45, were expecting baby No. 3 .
 “x Baby, I’m yours x,” the actress captioned her bump debut at the time.
 Hathaway flaunted her budding belly in a bikini during a St. Tropez vacation as well — and continued showing her pregnancy progress during her “Odyssey” press tour .

 During a “Late Night With Seth Meyers” appearance in July, the Golden Globe winner joked about her “buzzer beater” baby .
 While Hathaway and the jewelry designer “knew what [they] were doing” when they conceived their third child, they were “shocked it worked.”
 The Oscar nominee shared her excitement over meeting the new family member, saying, “I love the channel right now, so it’s just more of that. Oh, cool, a new cast member.”
 8 
 The following month, Hathaway (pictured above on July 14) called it her “buzzer beater.” GC Images 
 8 
 The Emmy winner (pictured above on July 16) was “shocked” when they conceived. MediaPunch / BACKGRID 
 Hathaway, notably, has opened up about her fertility struggles over the years, including sharing a 2015 miscarriage .
 In 2019, she told her Instagram followers , “For everyone going through infertility and conception hell, please know it was not a straight line to either of my pregnancies.”
 The Emmy winner explained to the Associated Press later that same year that her journey was “really painful and very isolating and full of self-doubt.”
 Before finding out baby No. 3 was on the way, Hathaway and Shulman had a “very low” expectation about conceiving, she told “Access Hollywood” in July.
 8 
 Hathaway (pictured above in July) and her partner had a “very low” expectation about conceiving. ABC 
 8 
 “We’re overjoyed because we just know from personal experience that not everybody gets this,” Hathaway (pictured above on June 30) gushed. Fernando Ramales / BACKGRID 
 “There’s always hope until there’s not, but when you get to a certain age, that hope looks like one percent to two percent,” she said. “We just decided to see where life took us.”
 “We’re overjoyed because we just know from personal experience that not everybody gets this, and certainly not when you want it — sometimes not ever,” Hathaway, who married Shulman in 2012, continued.
 She called her growing family a “blessing” she does not “take for granted.”
